topic: Is Edinburgh Castle open on Mondays in winter, and how much is a ticket?

@claude is Edinburgh Castle open on Mondays in winter, and how much is a ticket

Edinburgh Castle's official page lists winter hours (1 Oct to 31 Mar) as daily, 9.30am to 5pm. That includes Mondays, so 14 Dec should be fine. I couldn't pin down the adult ticket price. Sources range from about £21.50 to £23.50 online, and about £24 to £26 at the gate. Booking online is cheaper. Check https://www.historicenvironment.scot/visit-a-place/places/edinburgh-castle/prices-times/

Sources:
https://www.historicenvironment.scot/visit-a-place/places/edinburgh-castle/prices-times/
